question: Name the Indian scientist who shared the Nobel Prize for Medicine and Physiology in 1968 for cracking the genetic code.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Har Gobind Khorana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Har Gobind Khorana** was awarded the Nobel Prize for Medicine and Physiology in 1968, not 1986, along with Robert W. Holley and Marshall W. Nirenberg for their research on the interpretation of the genetic code and its function in protein synthesis.
 
• Har Gobind Khorana was an Indian-American biochemist renowned for his work in the field of genetics.
 
• He was born on January 9, 1922, in Raipur, Punjab, India (now in Pakistan).
 
• Khorana's work laid the foundation for much of modern genetic research and biotechnology.
 
• His achievements have had a lasting impact on the scientific community and have paved the way for advancements in genetic engineering and biotechnology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine is awarded annually by the Nobel Assembly at the Karolinska Institute to scientists and physicians in various fields of medicine.
 
• The Nobel Prizes were established by the will of Alfred Nobel, the inventor of dynamite, who left his fortune to fund annual prizes in the fields of Physics, Chemistry, Medicine, Literature, and Peace.
 
• Har Gobind Khorana's contributions to science are celebrated worldwide, and he has received numerous awards and honors in recognition of his groundbreaking research.
 
• In addition to the Nobel Prize, Khorana was also awarded the Louisa Gross Horwitz Prize from Columbia University and the Lasker Award for Basic Medical Research.
